    SELECT 
        name, version, step,
        MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score ELSE NULL END) as stack_score,
        MAX(CASE WHEN model != 'Stack' THEN test_score ELSE NULL END) as max_non_stack_score
    FROM model_score
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
model_status AS (
    SELECT 
        name, version,
        MAX(CASE WHEN max_non_stack_score < stack_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_strong,
        MAX(CASE WHEN max_non_stack_score = stack_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_soft
    FROM step_scores
    GROUP BY name, version
),
model_with_l1 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT name, version, L1_model
    FROM model
),
combined AS (
    SELECT ms.name, ms.version, m.L1_model, 'strong' as status
    FROM model_status ms
    JOIN model_with_l1 m ON ms.name = m.name AND ms.version = m.version
    WHERE ms.has_strong = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ms.name, ms.version, m.L1_model, 'soft' as status
    FROM model_status ms
    JOIN model_with_l1 m ON ms.name = m.name AND ms.version = m.version
    WHERE ms.has_soft = 1
),
l1_counts AS (
    SELECT status, L1_model, COUNT(*) as occurrence_count
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY status, L1_model
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT status, L1_model, occurrence_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC) as rn
    FROM l1_counts
)
SELECT status, L1_model, occurrence_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY status
